note: Correction sums are accumulated norms, not net movement. Shadow error is not a formal CF/I or visual success metric. Allocator peaks are not full-process VRAM.
cap_interpretation: For identical states and gradients, when the global cap is active the positive lambda scalar cancels from the applied full correction. Trajectories and floating-point arithmetic can still differ. Saved RAW distances and clip fractions diagnose closeness; they do not establish visual equivalence or failure.
